name: UI Theme
description: One accent color and appearance for game HUDs, timers, leaderboards, buttons, results and announcements.

changelog.notes: The guide points custom UI at the shared size set (uiSizes), the compact HUD pieces and the ready-made windows, so a HUD stays small and a shop or dialog is comfortable to tap on a phone.
Custom HUDs are placed through the shared HUD layout, which keeps them clear of the phone touch controls and of each other.
One accent color and dark or light appearance shared by the scene's game HUDs, buttons, timers, leaderboards and results.
